findings.text: blocking: `select_review_for_head` now returns None for an empty head (reckon/crew/recovery.py:329), but `_sub_floor_items_by_session` passes "" when `_reviewed_tree` finds no readable tree and relies on the newest-record fallback its own docstring documents at reckon/crew/obligations.py:641, so a live run with no readable worktree or repo and a stored review carrying a sub-floor dimension now produces no disposition duty; the classifier was rehoused to keep that fallback at reckon/crew/recovery.py:683 but this reader was not, so the "one selection" the fragment claims is not one.

follow-on: the fragment records base arm 168 passed at 18d9e07b0 and head arm 170 passed at 2b8f0e7a4 while the node's own manifest records 54 and 56 at c0abbb8ec and 0fc262e3f; the fragment is byte-identical to the reverted landing's copy (git diff 6ea9a15fa 0fc262e3f -- <fragment> is empty) and names revisions the node's commits do not contain, so the landed evidence artifact disagrees with the arms the run recorded.

follow-on: the manifest's changed_paths lists only the three code/test paths while the diff also lands docs/evidence/fragments/crew-runtime-positive-controls/reclaimed-run-review-keys-on-its-own-head.html, so a reader counting the node's changed paths from the manifest undercounts one.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against base c0abbb8ec; the re-apply (c93c371c7) restores the reverted change and the repair (0fc262e3f) branches `_stored_review` on `_worktree_reclaimed` so a headless non-reclaimed record still selects the newest stored review, +377/-32 over four files with no churn or unrelated edits.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done-when requires classify_pointer again to read a completed run holding a parsed stored review as promotable when the record names no resolvable head, an abbreviated commits: entry to resolve to its full id and never the shared checkout's HEAD, and no composed review for a reclaimed run with no resolvable head; the manifest records base c0abbb8ec 54 passed EXIT=0 and head 0fc262e3f 56 passed EXIT=0, with the reproduced regression at c93c371c7 (8 failed) in logs/regression-reproduction-before-fix.log, so the asserted measure is met by the recorded arms.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is that a reclaimed run's review keys on its own head while a stored review stays selectable for the classifier; the landed diff adds `_resolve_abbreviated_commit` (reckon/crew/recovery.py:1239) and `_worktree_reclaimed` (reckon/crew/recovery.py:1300), makes `_review_head_and_tree` return an empty head for a reclaimed record naming no resolvable head (reckon/crew/recovery.py:1315-1327), and has the classifier read the store's newest record for a non-reclaimed empty head (reckon/crew/recovery.py:683-686), which is that mechanism.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the reviewed run's manifest.md; status complete, commits c93c371c7 and 0fc262e3f, baseline_suite and after_suite are well-formed JSON naming revisions c0abbb8ec and 0fc262e3f with failure_count 0 each and absolute log paths, negative_control_log is a bare path, and measurement_module/measurement_cwd are recorded for the scratch base arm.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the fence's six declared paths; the diff touches four - reckon/crew/recovery.py, tests/test_reclaimed_run_review_head.py, tests/test_rereview_keeps_its_lane.py and the evidence fragment - all inside the granted scope, with no edit outside it.

justifications.durability: tests/test_reclaimed_run_review_head.py:162 asserts the nine-character citation resolves to run_head and not the checkout head, and the negative control reddens tests/test_crew_scoring_state.py:test_parsed_review_makes_completed_manifest_promotable, but the empty-head refusal it centralises is uncovered for the obligation producer at reckon/crew/obligations.py:698 which it also alters.
justifications.evidence: the arms are recorded at logs/base-arm-3.log and logs/head-arm.log and the negative control at logs/negative-control.log EXIT=1, but the landed fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/crew-runtime-positive-controls/reclaimed-run-review-keys-on-its-own-head.html:20 records different arm figures (168/170 at 18d9e07b0/2b8f0e7a4) than the manifest's (54/56 at c0abbb8ec/0fc262e3f).
justifications.fit: `_resolve_abbreviated_commit` (reckon/crew/recovery.py:1239) runs git rev-parse --verify with the module's existing subprocess idiom, and no added name carries a plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery.py:1315-1327 returns an empty head for a reclaimed record and reckon/crew/recovery.py:683-686 restores newest-record selection for the in-recovery classifier, which is the goal exactly.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff (reckon/crew/recovery.py, the two test files, the fragment) is inside the fence's granted write paths, with no edit to a peer's path or to the plan.
